evidence.observation: O2 at baseline ~4.6 ppm at start of growth
Monotonic rise 4.6→13.2→19.4→27.1→33.2 ppm over growth stage
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so rise is not a purge-gas fault
Pressure steady ~761 Torr, no exhaust blockage signature

args.missing_evidence: Whether O2 keeps rising (leak) or plateaus/decays (transient outgassing); response of O2 to an Ar flow step would discriminate leak vs outgassing.
